title: PP vs SS packing-density comparison for parallel two-qubit Rydberg-blockade gate arrays

methods.production: geometric lattice packing under FULL pairwise cross-talk exclusion (blockade radius + angle-dependent cross-talk radius, densest axis-aligned and staggered lattices)
methods.control: closed-form sixth-root scaling law (analytic), verified against the numerical packing
methods.magic_distance: zero-crossing analysis of the theta=0 pair potential V(r)=-C3/r^3-C6/r^6 (Vermersch2015 magic-distance condition)

conventions.c6_sign: interaction potential V(r) = -C6/r^6; C6<0 => repulsive, C6>0 => attractive; radii use magnitudes |C6|
conventions.angle: theta = angle between interatomic axis and quantization axis; theta=0 along quantization axis (decoupled), theta=90 perpendicular (blockaded/gate axis)
conventions.units: C6 in GHz*um^6; V_block, V_ct in GHz (energy/h); radii in um; density in atoms/um^2 (2D) or atoms/um^3 (3D)
conventions.geometry_2d: quantization axis IN plane; gate pair axis theta=90 (blockaded), rows stacked theta=0 (decoupled)
conventions.geometry_3d: quantization axis OUT of plane; in-plane directions theta=90, layer stacking theta=0

omega_2pi_mhz.anchored_to: canonical Rydberg gate Rabi frequency (Rb n~75, Omega/2pi=10 MHz)
omega_2pi_mhz.note: k_block = 1 (Saffman blockade radius convention V(Rb) = hbar*Omega)

v_block_ghz.anchored_to: blockade radius Rb defined by collective Rabi ~ vdW shift: V(Rb)=hbar*Omega
v_block_ghz.quote: sqrt(eta R_b^3) Omega ~ V(R_b) -- collective Rabi frequency comparable to the vdW shift defines R_b

v_ct_ghz.anchored_to: measured inter-site cross-talk between parallel Rydberg gate sites ~10 kHz
v_ct_ghz.quote: Cross-talk between gate sites is on the scale of 10 kHz and 'should be negligible.'

r_trap_um.quote: atom spacing 2 um with blockade V_Ryd/2pi ~ 450 MHz

geometric lattice packing under full pairwise exclusion (densest packing)
method_ladder.planned_method: analytic sixth-root closed form (primary) cross-validated against numerical lattice packing (control)
method_ladder.used: both: analytic sixth-root closed form + numerical full-pairwise lattice packing (axis-aligned + staggered)

quantities.observable: 2D packing-density gain rho_PP/rho_SS (quantization axis in-plane), sixth-root scaling law. Settled value at n=60 (wide-window theta=0 residual): 1.38 analytic / 1.315 numerical-densest (staggered). Canonical operating point n=75: 1.48 (theta=0 residual window-limited, indicative).
quantities.uncertainty_source: envelope of (a) theta=90 near-Forster treatment spread 268.08-299.11 GHz um^6 -> gain 1.355-1.380 (1.7%, sixth-root suppressed), (b) rectangular-vs-staggered packing definition 1.315-1.380 (4.7%, SS triangular advantage), and (c) the n=75 theta=0 window-limited residual (window-20 -128.76 is likely ~1.5x too large, pushing the n=75 gain toward ~1.6). Absolute sigma 0.1 covers [1.29, 1.48].

quantities.observable: 3D packing-density gain at n=60 (quantization axis out-of-plane), analytic sixth-root law (= numerical packing to <0.01%)
quantities.uncertainty_source: theta=90 treatment spread 268.08-299.11 -> gain 1.237-1.192 (3.7%); analytic and numerical packing agree to <0.01% at each treatment

quantities.observable: 2D packing-density gain at n=75 (canonical operating point), analytic sixth-root law; CAVEAT: theta=0 residual -128.76 GHz um^6 uses the +/-20 GHz energy window (window-limited, likely overestimate), so this gain is INDICATIVE
quantities.uncertainty_source: dominated by the theta=0 window-limited residual (window-20 -128.76 is likely ~1.5x too large, as at n=60 where window-20 gives -16.16 vs settled -10.41); if the n=75 residual is ~1.5x smaller the gain rises toward ~1.6

quantities.observable: sixth-root decoupled-direction factor (|C6_SS|/|C6_0|)^(1/6) at n=60, the row-direction (theta=0) gain contribution
quantities.uncertainty_source: C6_0 uncertainty 0.3 GHz um^6 (2.9%) -> sixth-root 0.5%; C6_SS QDT floor 2.5% -> 0.4%

quantities.observable: sixth-root gate-direction factor (|C6_SS|/|C6_90|)^(1/6) at n=60, the penalty from PP being stronger than SS at theta=90
magnitude offset C6_SS / C6_PP(theta=90) at n=60 (the gate-direction strength ratio that partially cancels the anisotropy gain; frame headline quantity)
quantities.uncertainty_source: theta=90 treatment spread 268.08-299.11 -> ratio 0.518-0.464 (10%, sixth-root suppresses to ~1.7% in the gain)

quantities.observable: critical anisotropy A_crit = (|C6_90|/|C6_SS|)^2 above which the 2D PP gain exceeds 1
2D packing gain if the theta=0 residual were negligible (C6_0 -> 0, trap floor 2 um); DIAGONAL-LIMITED, not trap-limited
quantities.uncertainty_source: rectangular-lattice diagonal-bound value 1.471 vs numerical staggered 1.341; the binding constraint is the diagonal neighbor at theta~30 deg (from the gate pair's finite theta=90 extent d_gate=5.47 um), NOT the trap floor

verdicts.statement: the 2D gain is the SIXTH ROOT of the anisotropy product (~1.38x), NOT the full ~26x anisotropy ratio

the diagonal neighbor is NOT the binding constraint on the quantization-axis spacing at n=60 (cross-talk-limited): the theta=0 same-column neighbor sets it (R_ct(0)=10.07 um); the diagonal at theta=28.5 deg sits at 1.15x margin
the Vermersch2015 magic-distance mechanism cannot cancel the theta=0 residual interaction (c-coupling vanishes at theta=0), so it cannot raise the gain

magic_distance_conclusion.reason: Field-free theta=0 case (C3 = 0): V(r) = -C6/r^6 is monotonic in r, so no zero crossing exists. Per Vermersch2015, the magic distance arises from the Zeeman c-coupling proportional to the angular matrix D(theta), which vanishes at theta=0 (the |m,m> states are pure-blockade eigenstates there); hence no magic distance exists at theta=0 in the field-free case.

binding_constraint_n60.cross_talk_limited: quantization-axis (theta=0) spacing set by the same-column neighbor at R_ct(0)=10.07 um, NOT the diagonal; gate-axis spacing set by R_ct(90)+d_gate = 22.77 um; the diagonal (0,d_gate)-(L_z,0) at theta=28.5 deg has 1.15x margin
binding_constraint_n60.trap_limited_residual_negligible: the DIAGONAL neighbor (theta~30 deg, from the gate pair's finite theta=90 extent) becomes the binding constraint, capping L_z at 9.45 um instead of the 2 um trap floor

cross_validation_plan.control_method: numerical full-pairwise lattice packing (axis-aligned + staggered), independent of the analytic closed form
numerical full-pairwise lattice packing, independent of the analytic closed form

cross_validation.method_b: numerical full-pairwise lattice packing (densest, staggered allowed)
cross_validation.note: agree to 4.7%. The gap is NOT the diagonal neighbor (rectangular diagonal has 1.15x margin); it is the SS baseline using a staggered (triangular-like) lattice, which is ~11% denser than the rectangular SS lattice. Both methods give ~1.3-1.4x, not ~26x.

cross_validation.method_b: direct geometric 3D density ratio from blockade/cross-talk radii (orthorhombic SS vs PP unit cells, d_gate terms retained, no sixth-root product formula assumed)
cross_validation.note: independent geometric-density-ratio method agrees with the analytic sixth-root to ~1e-16, verifying the d_gate terms cancel exactly in 3D; staggering does not help in 3D (the optimizer reduces to the orthorhombic lattice).

premise_corrections.premise: user premise: '0 degree almost no interaction', so PP gates can be packed ~26x denser along the decoupled axis
premise_corrections.corrected: E1 settled the theta=0 residual at C6=-10.41 GHz um^6 (7.5% of SS C6). This gives a theta=0 cross-talk radius of 10.07 um, so the row-direction sixth-root factor is only (|C6_SS/C6_0|)^(1/6)=1.54, not 26.

premise_corrections.premise: packing gain scales with the full anisotropy ratio (~26-29x)
premise_corrections.corrected: the gain is the SIXTH ROOT of the anisotropy: gain_D = [(|C6_SS/C6_0|)(|C6_SS/C6_90|)^(D-1)]^(1/6), because blockade/cross-talk radii scale as C6^(1/6). The PP gate-direction strength (C6_90=268 vs C6_SS=139) partially offsets the decoupled-direction gain.
premise_corrections.consequence: even the full 26-29x anisotropy yields only ~1.38x (2D) / ~1.24x (3D)

premise_corrections.premise: in the trap-limited (negligible residual) regime the theta=0 spacing is set by the optical trap floor and the gain is ~R_ctSS/R_trap ~ 7x
premise_corrections.corrected: the DIAGONAL neighbor (gate pair's finite theta=90 extent d_gate=5.47 um) binds at theta~30 deg, capping L_z at 9.45 um instead of the 2 um trap floor. The trap-limited gain is ~1.47x (rectangular) / ~1.34x (staggered), not ~7x.
premise_corrections.consequence: even with a zero residual, the sin^4(theta) interaction at intermediate angles from the offset gate-pair atoms limits the gain to ~1.3-1.5x

computed.acceptance_criterion: Confirmatory. Predict at n=60 (wide-window-settled): (1) the 2D packing-density gain rho_PP/rho_SS equals the sixth-root scaling law gain_2d = [(|C6_SS/C6_0|)(|C6_SS/C6_90|)]^(1/6) within 15% (central ~1.38, clearly NOT the full ~26x anisotropy); (2) the two sixth-root factors are f_dec=(|C6_SS/C6_0|)^(1/6) in [1.3,1.8] and f_gate=(|C6_SS/C6_90|)^(1/6) in [0.75,0.95]; (3) the diagonal neighbor is NOT the binding constraint on the quantization-axis spacing at n=60 (the theta=0 same-column neighbor sets it; analytic law and full-pairwise packing agree <5%); (4) the magic-distance mechanism cannot raise the gain. Verdict reads computed.packing_gain_2d, computed.gain_2d_n60_packing, computed.factor_decoupled_n60, computed.factor_gate_n60, computed.binding_constraint_n60, computed.magic_distance_conclusion. CONFIRMED iff (1) gain matches sixth-root within 15% and is < the 26x anisotropy; (2) f_dec in [1.3,1.8] and f_gate in [0.75,0.95]; (3) diagonal not binding / methods agree <5%; (4) magic-distance refuted. Single-fault response: an artifact returning gain=1.0 fails (1); one returning gain=26 (the full anisotropy) fails (1); one returning isotropic packing fails (2)/(3).
